Manifest.Description: 1.25 applies the global dialogue/text revision across the common, romance, harem, attendant and revolution scripts, with matching Chinese/English text and the latest Japanese/Korean localization. The 1.24 native-action-only lowball rule, 1.23 Wilde preparation tip, 1.22 counterfeit-inspection reaction, 1.21 Korean register/name fixes, 1.20 localization, 1.18 HD CGs/maid schedule, 1.17 cross-mod compatibility and earlier fixes remain. Story routes, choice outcomes, target days and endings are unchanged. 1.25 应用全局文案修订，覆盖共同线、恋爱线、后宫线、侍从线与革命军线对白，并同步中英文及最新日语/韩语本地化。保留 1.24 原生操作压价判定、1.23 王尔德筹备提示、1.22 假货检查反应、1.21 韩语语域与译名修正、1.20 本地化、1.18 高清 CG 与侍从线排期、1.17 跨 MOD 兼容及更早修复。不改路线、选项结果、目标日或结局。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
